status: pending dispatcher admission; diagnostic, no host repair established

build_environment.PYRY_BIN: unset before admission; wrapper builds mobile/build/e2e-bin/pyry

binary_verification: read actual rebuilt binary with debug/buildinfo; require clean vcs.revision and e2e_realclaude tag; export actual SHA-256; reject prebuilt override
tree_derivation: merge three full recursive Git trees; only InteractiveStreamE2ETest.kt changes on both sides; git merge-file without conflicts; recomputed each input root tree against commit.tree.sha
selection_semantics: 65-method filter, not execution ordering; retain ordinary suite scheduling and all original assertions; no failed-method retry
admission: python3 scripts/android-test-gate.py live --tests <all 65 Class#method names, comma-separated in historical selection order>
wrapper_installation: Run current pinned compatibility wrapper/agent-tool with the pinned mobile-agents admission implementation against the reconstructed mobile test tree; historical suite script stays pinned. Record this tooling-only substitution separately from product source.
run_limit_owner: dispatcher supervises admitted wrapper; current wrapper has no subprocess timeout; stop and retain incomplete named results at this bound
home_contract: Only wrapper child HOME points to this durable test-owned directory. Historical LIVE uses inherited HOME as daemon workdir. Preserve absolute ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_USER_HOME, ANDROID_AVD_HOME, GRADLE_USER_HOME, JAVA_HOME and GOCACHE before launching. Use wrapper-owned authentication; do not copy operator HOME, private configuration or credentials.

configuration.original_configuration: unknown; test-owned substitutes must be separately recorded

configuration_setup: Seed test-owned .pyry/config.json and credential-free .claude.json onboarding/workspace trust settings; wrapper supplies authenticated child environment. Read back actual effective settings and session settings. Startup roles not witnessed must remain unknown; do not manufacture MCP/hook entry.
ownership: Wrapper-generated e2e-auto primary and second-host instances belong to this run; peer is an independent device; bypass and answer instances remain separately owned. Header observer records private instance/process/connection joins; export uses ordinals. Never count pre-restart children as retained afterward.

private_input.TargetPrompt: Read exact target prompt privately from the pinned mobile method; never export it

resource_sampler: go test -tags e2e_realclaude -run ^TestReadinessEmulatorResources$ -timeout 75m ./internal/e2e/realclaude; set PYRY_E2E_READINESS_EMULATOR_INPUT to private input.json; start before admitted wrapper and await capture-complete on completion/cancellation; stop/join sidecar and all owned daemons before export. Private binary, observations, resources and persistence paths must be populated. Actual owned executables must equal the clean rebuilt Binary.
export: From the clean final handoff checkout, after admitted acquisition and joined cleanup, run TestReadinessEmulatorExport with PYRY_E2E_READINESS_EMULATOR_INPUT. It validates typed provenance, runner status, resolved readbacks, persisted target and independent owned resources; exports sanitized XML durations and full named inventory including incomplete methods. It never starts Android and refuses an existing exported run. Both destination and recovery copies are deny-scanned and all pins/semantic joins are validated.
return_trip: needs-live-artifacts stays until builder recovers these eight exact usable files, validates source/binary/settings/status/inventory/ownership/persistence/resource hashes and semantic joins with return_checks, commits and pushes to PR #3201. TestReadinessRuntimeRetained must require the concrete emulator run using PYRY_E2E_READINESS_REQUIRE_EMULATOR=1 on return. Missing/unusable or zero-executed records are blockers; usable partial evidence remains incomplete and never proves the full selection or a repair.
remaining_unknowns: MCP/SessionStart role entry where absent; named XML alone does not attribute method intervals to host requests
subsequent_owners: Dispatcher owns subsequent full host gate; mobile #2010 owns fresh full mobile acceptance with unchanged ping/source-copy/hidden-timestamp/staged-quote/focus/keyboard/no-send assertions.
exporter_checkout: Use the final clean feature/3071 handoff checkout for exporter/readers and this updated contract. Build the instrumented host from daemon_revision in its separate clean checkout via PYRYCODE_SRC. Source support bytes are pinned below and are identical; the later commit changes capture metadata only.

instrumentation_status_capture.source: Timestamp the existing admitted runner child instrumentation output as it is streamed, before buffering or XML generation. Preserve every class/test/INSTRUMENTATION_STATUS_CODE start and terminal line; no XML-derived ordering. Keep raw status private. No product, assertions or method scheduling changes.
instrumentation_status_capture.boundaries: Started/Ended are runner-host status receipts, not unmeasured Android device emit times. Export observed intervals/outcomes and XML durations independently. Unresolved method/request joins remain unknown.
instrumentation_status_capture.partial: On cancellation retain status and any available XML; observed terminal status is retained even if XML is absent. Started-but-unfinished and unreached selected methods remain incomplete. Never fabricate skips or rerun the selection.

acquisition_provenance_input.clock_comparison: Bracket adb device date with host UTC reads; retain measured device-minus-host offset and comparison time. If unavailable, record device-clock-unavailable with null offset. Method receipt times stay on the runner host clock. Never infer device send or phone receipt from host queuing.
acquisition_provenance_input.derived_fields: Methods, Settings, Targets and TargetAcquisition are derived by coupled readers from status, readbacks and persisted snapshots, not supplied claims.

effective_readbacks_input.source: Read actual owned daemon runtime settings/control replies and its test-owned persisted session/configuration files; resolve runtime flag defaults against the pinned composition root and record applied overrides. Join observed owner, lifetime and bound session, never just conversation/session spelling. Readbacks are contemporaneous per owned restart/target. Never copy operator configuration or raw argv into portable evidence.
effective_readbacks_input.unknowns: Do not invent effective values. Sidecar persistence-only settings cannot stand in for missing target runtime readbacks. Missing original settings stay explicit; empty/substitute roles are separately classified. MCP/SessionStart entry/readiness/completion is unknown when no actual witness exists.

persistence_sidecar: TestReadinessEmulatorResources appends private persistence-snapshots.jsonl while each owned daemon is alive, retaining registry binding and history entry identities before replacement/deletion/restart. It validates process start ticks and rebuilt executable hash, uses separate per-owner/lifetime current descendant CPU intervals and child RSS, and exits after the completion sentinel. No raw payload/ID/path survives portable export.
